requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed bottles with 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, and a larger bottle size for CMY (>8,000 pages).
requirements.Rationale: To support higher printing volumes and reduce frequency of bottle replacement, improving user convenience and competitiveness in high-volume segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with existing ink system and printer hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer accepts new NGB keyed bottles, Black and CMY yield meets or exceeds 6,000 pages, CMY bottle size supports >8,000 pages as validated by yield tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability in Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the ink bottle and tank system achieves spill-free reliability during user handling and refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes mess and potential damage, improving customer satisfaction and reducing support incidents.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design of bottle interface and tank opening.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills in 99% of user refill scenarios as demonstrated in usability and reliability testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly - Filter) featuring a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, with no change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances filtration and identification, while maintaining user familiarity with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on existing push-push and TDF design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F incorporates metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and passes all functional and reliability tests without changes to click-on push-push and TDF.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without ink reformulation for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost, leveraging proven technologies.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility validation with new system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks function reliably in Magellan with no reformulation required.

requirements.Title: Reliability, WVTR, Air Gain, Flow Rate, and IDS Characterization
requirements.Description: Perform comprehensive characterization and modeling of reliability, Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, and Ink Delivery System (IDS) including startup and NOA-F End-of-Life (EOL).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust, predictable printer operation and ink system performance throughout the product lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires test platform and simulation models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented test reports and models showing all parameters within specified tolerances under expected use conditions.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling for Tank and PQ Impact
requirements.Description: Develop models for ink stability in the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents print defects and ensures consistent output over time.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires access to ink formulation data and tank environment parameters.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Model predicts ink stability and PQ impact; test results confirm predictions within acceptable margins.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Part in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Make NOA-F available as a service part for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables efficient servicing and minimizes downtime for users under warranty.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires service logistics and inventory planning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is listed and available as a service part in warranty system; service teams trained on replacement.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Implement Acumen 6 identification/technology on the bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: Improves traceability, anti-counterfeiting, or smart feature enablement.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with lid manufacturing process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is present and functional on all bottle lids as verified in production samples.

requirements.Title: Modify SA14 Line for NOA-F and Add Magi Ink Cart & Labelling Tool in Orcus 5
requirements.Description: Update factory configuration to modify the existing SA14 line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new component integration and ensures manufacturing readiness.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on final NOA-F and Magi ink design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line and Orcus 5 updated, validated by successful pilot builds.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer to support customer-replaceable PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F components.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires mechanical design enabling easy access and replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F without tools, verified by usability testing.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Set a new warranty page life target for the printer at 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with higher usage expectations and competitive offerings.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires validation of all components for 80k page life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and key components meet or exceed 80,000 pages in accelerated life tests and warranty documentation reflects new target.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID design with an increased tank size. No changes to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates higher ink capacity for extended printing without increasing device footprint unnecessarily.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and chassis design constraints.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device incorporates larger tank as per new design, validated by fit, form, and function tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Compliance with environmental and energy standards is required for market access and sustainability goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires certification process and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all relevant certifications for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to align with the new tank protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures paper handling reliability and maintains device compactness despite larger tank.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on final tank design and printer layout.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays operate smoothly and reliably with new tank design, confirmed by paper path and mechanical tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch Color Graphic Display (CGD) as the main user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience with a larger, clearer interface for settings and status.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires updated UI design and hardware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is functional, passes usability and reliability tests, and supports all required UI features.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Utilize Sayan Sibstar tubes with a new routing and integration approach for ink delivery.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink flow reliability and supports new tank layout.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and chassis design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube routing supports reliable ink delivery and passes all system tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management with Spit Platform Changes
requirements.Description: Update service station design for improved aerosol management due to tank changes and spit platform modifications.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality with new ink/tank configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires validation with new tank and spit platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within safe limits during operation, as verified by environmental and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable printhead movement and system longevity with new mechanical configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on finalized component weights and tube layout.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within specified force and speed limits, validated by dynamic testing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to reliably support the new 80,000-page life goal.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents jams and wear, ensuring consistent operation over extended product life.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on new page life and component durability requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components show no significant wear or failure after 80,000 cycles in accelerated life tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceable Ink Maintenance Part Post 80k Life
requirements.Description: Designate an ink maintenance part as serviceable at service centers after 80,000-page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates post-warranty maintenance and extends device usability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires part identification and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Part is listed as serviceable, and service procedures are documented and tested.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and fluidic interface (FI) connection for the Ink Delivery System.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and serviceability of ink connections.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design and validation of new connection system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New FI connection passes reliability and leak tests under all use conditions.

requirements.Title: Increase LEBI Ink Tank Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Increase the size of the LEBI ink tank, add keying features, and implement LOI (Line of Identity) SHAID (Security Hardware Authentication ID).
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yield, prevents incorrect installation, and enhances security.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank design and SHAID implementation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank meets new size and keying requirements, LOI SHAID is functional and validated.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management process for the Ink Delivery System.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable operation and prevents air-related print issues.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with IDS hardware and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup process reliably primes ink system and prevents air locks, as verified in system tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and define depletion criteria to match page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output quality and transparent yield claims for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires updated test protocols and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality meets or exceeds new goals through the defined depletion period, as validated in tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL for Workspace (WS)
requirements.Description: Leverage the existing Marconi Hi PDL (Page Description Language) for workspace functionality.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development effort and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new system software.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Workspace supports Marconi Hi PDL without functional regressions.

requirements.Title: MISR and EE Reuse of Existing Components
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, and Stingray Wi-Fi module for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time, cost, and risk by leveraging existing, validated components.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility validation with new platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components function as intended in Magellan system integration tests.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Adopt the Dune firmware platform for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Provides a modern, flexible firmware base for new features and updates.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires porting and validation for Magellan hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dune firmware runs on Magellan hardware and passes all functional and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product security and compliance with HP security standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with hardware and firmware platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security features pass all penetration and compliance tests.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve print speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard and 25/19 ppm for PDL mode.
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive benchmarks and user expectations for throughput.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on system performance and print engine capability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in standard and PDL modes in performance tests.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and Onboarding Solutions
requirements.Description: Provide support for Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS), WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP paths.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and supports modern business models and customer onboarding.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and service integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All solution paths are documented and functional in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution, SMB Manageability, and Enterprise Support (WJA, HPSM, JAM)
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solutions, SMB manageability, and enterprise support including WJA (Web Jetadmin), HPSM (HP Smart Management), and JAM (JetAdvantage Management).
requirements.Rationale: Meets business customer requirements for device management and workflow integration.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software integration and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan, manageability, and enterprise support features function as specified in enterprise environments.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers Support (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD)
requirements.Description: Support a range of client software and drivers including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and ease of deployment for various customer segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires driver and software development and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are supported and pass compatibility tests on launch.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Constraint)
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA component life is constrained to 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Defines maintenance and replacement intervals for critical printhead assembly.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires alignment with warranty and service parts planning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA consistently achieves 65,000-page life in accelerated tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 80,000 Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Printer warranty covers up to 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns warranty with expected usage and market standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on component reliability and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly documented and communicated to customers.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the printer for easy maintenance box replacement to improve serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for end users and service providers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires mechanical design for easy access.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by service personnel in under 5 minutes as validated by service tests.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Optionally support host 12,000-page CMYK and trade page 6,000-page yields as flexible features.
requirements.Rationale: Provides flexibility for different market segments and promotional offerings.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink system and SKU definition.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be configured to support these yields as needed for specific SKUs.
